cards.heading: Definition: attested computation
cards.question: What is an attested computation, and what does it let a consumer confirm?
cards.answer: A document carrying not just what a value means but the sanctioned way to produce it — runtime, typed parameters, the computation, an executor-plus-receipt, and a deterministic checker — so a consumer can mechanically confirm a shown number came from running the blessed computation, not something an agent improvised.

cards.heading: Mechanism: parameter-only agent surface
cards.question: What is the agent allowed to supply in an attested computation, and how does that turn verification into a string comparison?
cards.answer: Only values for declared parameters — it must never author or edit the computation itself; the checker re-derives the same binding and compares it against the actual expanded, compiled artifact the receipt carries, so a rewritten query or swapped file simply fails to match.

cards.heading: Fidelity: re-read, not agent-reported
cards.question: How is fidelity established for the value an agent displays, and what gap does this close?
cards.answer: The displayed value is re-read from the receipt's authoritative source by job identifier, not taken from the agent's own text — closing the gap where a correct run is reported alongside an incorrect number.

cards.heading: Verification vs. attestation
cards.question: How do verification and attestation differ in this pattern, and why are both required?
cards.answer: Verification confirms a definition still matches policy (document-level, slow, stored); attestation confirms one run produced its value legitimately (per-call, runtime, never stored) — so a stale definition can still attest cleanly, and a freshly verified definition still needs attestation on every run.

cards.heading: Why trust state is per computation
cards.question: Why is each computation its own document, with its own trust state?
cards.answer: Because the runtime gives parameters their meaning, one computation can back many consumers, and trust is per computation — revenue, profit and margin, for instance, each expire and attest independently.
